replaces: the single data_displacement number, which was not authoritative
why_old_metric_wrong: compared DATA emission ticks up to first_echo_tick; with no echo the horizon became u64::MAX and silently diffed two whole trajectories, reporting disp=376..382 on runs whose treatment emitted at most 3 probes

scheduler_data_displacement.value: count of ticks where baseline emitted DATA and treatment did not
scheduler_data_displacement.rationale: before any extra packet exists there is no legitimate divergence; non-zero is a real scheduler defect

channel_fate_divergence.rationale: one extra packet advances the shared GE chain by one step, legitimately re-phasing every subsequent fate

echo_bounded_rule: any metric whose window depends on an Echo reports 'N/A - NO ECHO' when none arrives; it never silently expands to the whole trace
positive_controls: no extra packets => whole-trace divergence = 0 with bootstrap OFF
one extra Probe advances the shared chain exactly once (forward_steps differs by probes_emitted)
a run with channel_fate_divergence > 0 must still have scheduler_data_displacement == 0
reporting_rule: scheduler_data_displacement is a safety gate input; channel_fate_divergence is descriptive only and never a gate, defect, or displacement claim
